item.title: Man convicted of murdering UCCS professor in 2024 facing harsher sentence due to previous crimes
item.description: The man convicted of murdering a University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS) professor in 2024 learned Friday he will be facing a harsher sentence due to previous crimes.

item.title: Colorado Parks and Wildlife releases cause of death of Routt County grey wolf
item.description: Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) has released the cause of death of a grey wolf in Routt County back in January.

item.title: Lt. Governor Dianne Primavera stops by the U.S. Olympic and Paralympic Museum
item.description: The Paralympics are one week away in Milan Cortina! Friday, Lieutenant Governor Dianne Primavera stopped by the United States Olympic and Paralympic Museum in Colorado Springs.
